title: Hub attendant
leads: Nobody. You look after every phone in the hub, from the first bag to the morning pickup.
where: Inside one upload hub: downtown, East Cairo, or West Cairo
hours: Nights. From the first bag in the evening to the morning pickup, before 7:00 AM
summary: You run one upload hub overnight: count, dock, upload, charge, log, and hand back every phone empty.

posting.headline: Hub attendant (night upload hub), Cairo
posting.about: We run video recording teams at factories, warehouses, farms, and construction sites across Cairo. Workers wear a small camera on a cap while they do their normal job. Every night the phones come to an upload hub, upload over fiber, and go back empty before the morning shift. A hub attendant runs one hub through the night.
do: Work nights, from the first bag to the morning pickup before 7:00 AM.
Get the room ready: cables free, router on, dashboard open, log dated.
Count every bag with the runner against its phone list. Both of you sign.
Dock every phone, check its storage, and start the upload.
Walk the racks every hour and replug any phone that stopped.
Before the runner comes back, check the dashboard. A few videos still waiting is fine. A full phone stays.
Repack by site, count with the runner, and sign the new phone list.
Send Mano the night's numbers before 7:00 AM: phones in, out, and held.
Report any absence by 8:00 PM the night before.
need: 18 years or older, with a national ID.
Able to work nights and stay alert until morning.
Careful with equipment and honest with numbers.
Able to read a dashboard and write a clear log.
plus: You have worked a night shift before.
You have set up a router before.
offer: A steady monthly wage, paid on time.
Paid training. Your manager works your first night with you.
A clear job with a clear list.
One room, one line, one log. Nobody else touches your phones.
posting.apply: Send your name, your age, your area, your phone number, and the hub closest to you. We call you back within two working days.

offer.heading: Offer of employment
paragraphs: We are pleased to offer you the position of Hub attendant at KMSC. You will report to {manager}, Chief of Staff.
Your start date is {start}. Your first night is paid training, worked with {manager}.

terms.label: Hours
terms.v: Nights, from the first bag to the morning pickup before 7:00 AM

terms.label: Pay
terms.v: {pay} per month, paid at the end of the month

conditions: A copy of your national ID that shows you are 18 or older.
Your signature on the consent form and the fraud briefing.
One account in your own name. Accounts are never shared.
Your first night, worked with {manager} and signed off.
expect: Every bag is counted against its phone list and signed by you and the runner.
No phone leaves the hub before the dashboard shows it empty.
Only you and the runner touch the phones. A phone that goes home ends the job.
offer.closing: Please sign below to accept this offer. We look forward to working with you.

handbook.purpose: The client pays only for footage that reaches them. Every night the phones come to your hub. By 7:00 AM each one must be back at its site, empty and charged. Every count, every cable, and every log line is yours.
outcomes: Every bag counted against its phone list and signed by two people.
Every phone leaves empty and charged, or stays and its Portfolio Manager knows.
Mano has the night's three numbers before 7:00 AM.
daily: Evening. Cables free, router on, dashboard open, log dated.
Each bag. Count by device number with the runner. Both sign. Wrong number: call Moharam now.
Then. Dock every phone, one per cable. Check the storage. Watch until all show uploading.
Every hour. Walk the racks. Replug a stopped phone. Still stuck: log it.
10:00 PM. Every run on the plan is in, or Moharam knows which is not.
Before the runner comes. Check the dashboard. A few videos left is fine. A full phone stays.
Early morning. Repack by site, new phone list, count with the runner, both sign.
Before 7:00 AM. Send Mano phones in, phones out, phones held and why. Lock up.
By 8:00 PM the night before. Tell Mano about any absence. He covers the hub.
weekly: Thursday, 4:00 PM. Confirm the tag of every held phone for the weekly count.
Thursday night. The full flush: every site's phones come in.
monthly: Go through the month's log with Mano. Agree on what to change.
standards: Count by device number. Sign only the real count.
One phone per cable. Storage checked on every phone you dock.
A phone leaves empty or not at all.
Only you and the runner touch the phones.
Mano owns the hub line and the gear. Ask him first.
never: Never send a phone back with videos still on it.
Never upload from anyone's home to get around a dead line.
A phone that goes home with you ends the job.
Saying the client's name to anyone outside the company ends the job.

firstMonth.what: Mano works it with you. You do every count and log line. He signs you off.
You run the hub alone. Mano reads your log and signed lists every morning.
No phone leaves full, no count is off, and Mano has your numbers before 7:00 AM.

measures: Counts that matched the phone list, every night.
Phones that left the hub full: zero.
Phones stuck for more than an hour, per week.
Three numbers to Mano before 7:00 AM, every day.
handbook.call: Mano, now, for the line, the router, or the gear. Moharam, now, for a run, a runner, or a count. Line down: restart the router once, then call Mano. Moharam sends the runs to the next hub.
